pathogens-vector-cycle.alt: Left: a cycle of three boxes. 1: a mosquito bites an infected person and picks up the pathogen. 2: the mosquito carries it. 3: it bites a healthy person, who gets sick and can infect the next mosquito. Malaria, West Nile virus and Zika virus spread this way. Right: climate bands from the equator outward. The mosquito range today covers the tropics; a dashed outline shows it stretching into subtropical and temperate bands as winters get milder.
